LOOK: Electric tricycles travel along Commonwealth Avenue in Quezon City on Friday, January 2, 2026, as restrictions on e-bikes and e-trikes on major roads take effect starting January 2, 2026, after it was moved from the original date of implementation on December 1, 2025.

The Land Transportation Office said the measure aims to improve road safety and traffic flow on major thoroughfares, with violators facing vehicle impoundment. | via Maria Tan, ABS-CBN News
